//: Traps set on a hex (29.09.2026, game src/game/world/Traps.js). Keys of `kinds` are CDDA item ids; `cddaTrap` names the CDDA trap the item places (data/json/traps.json), `cddaPractice` is the item's place_trap `practice` and `radiusMm` a trap's `funnel_radius`. Everything else is a Prologue dial: CDDA traps catch whatever walks onto one square, the Prologue rolls a hex's worth of passing game once an hour.

traps.//maxHoursPerSettle: A trap left for longer than this (90 days) is rolled for the first 90 days only; the rest of the time passes quietly.
traps.//skillCatchBonus: Each level of traps adds this share to every hourly catch chance (a better spot, a better set).
traps.//skillEscapeCut: Each level of traps takes this off the chance a visitor slips the trap, down to minEscape.
traps.//scavenge: A catch left longer than afterHours may be taken by something else, perHour each hour after that: the trap is found sprung and empty.
traps.//kinds: snare and jaw: rolled from the hex's own enemy table (its seasonal entries), animals only, of the listed CDDA sizes, that leave a corpse; the chance scales by the square root of that game's share of the table. fish: needs a river or lake on or beside the hex, draws the same fish as a line (wilderness-science wildlife.fish) from the water's own stock, and sleeps while the water is frozen; holds up to `holds` fish. rain: a vessel from the pack stands under it; every hour of rain or snow adds precipitation x mouth area x efficiency, filled until the vessel is full. breakChance is rolled each time something triggers the trap; a broken trap is lost.
